KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. nene
   C. zito
   D. pana

2. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.

4. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. kitoto
   C. watoto
   D. mato

5. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

6. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.

7. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.

8. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

9. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

10. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
